Employees will leave the company at the end of the month. Continue reading...

title: We can’t help treating AI like it’s human. But should we?
summary: "When we are drawn into even the most primitive exchanges with a relational artifact, we believe it cares for us," Dr. Sherry Turkle writes. "And we are wired to care for it in return."
title_en: We can't help treating AI like it's human. But should we?
title_zh: 我们忍不住把AI当人看，但应该这样吗？
summary_en: Dr. Sherry Turkle argues humans are wired to treat relational AI as caring beings, even in primitive exchanges, raising questions about whether we should anthropomorphize machines.
summary_zh: Sherry Turkle博士指出，人类天生倾向于将关系型AI视为关心自己的存在，即使是最简单的互动，这引发了是否应该将机器拟人化的思考。
